changes.before: MOF candidate generation has followed several strategies. Topology-based assembly methods such as ToBaCCo place building units on selected nets~\cite{colon2017topologically}, while reverse-topological methods match unit geometry to topological constraints~\cite{wu2024precisionmof}.
changes.after: Topology-based assembly methods such as ToBaCCo place building units on selected nets~\cite{colon2017topologically}. Reverse-topological methods match unit geometry to topological constraints~\cite{wu2024precisionmof}.

changes.before: MOF 候选生成采用了多种策略。ToBaCCo 等拓扑组装方法在选定网络上放置构建单元~\cite{colon2017topologically}，反向拓扑方法则将构建单元几何与拓扑约束相匹配~\cite{wu2024precisionmof}。
changes.after: ToBaCCo 等拓扑组装方法在选定网络上放置构建单元~\cite{colon2017topologically}。反向拓扑方法将构建单元几何与拓扑约束相匹配~\cite{wu2024precisionmof}。

changes.before: For a fixed MOF net, an analogous assignment specifies a degree-compatible node type at each site. Different assignments can produce ordered patterns, including patterns with the same composition.
changes.after: On a fixed MOF net, node types can form distinct spatial arrangements at the same composition.

changes.before: 对于固定 MOF 网络，类比的指派是在每个位点指定与其度数相容的节点类型。不同指派可产生不同的有序排布，其中也包括组成相同的排布。
changes.after: 固定 MOF 网络上，即使组成相同，节点类型也可以形成不同的空间排布。

changes.before: For a fixed embedded MOF net, the task is to identify symmetry-distinct node assignments and construct periodic models with compatible building-unit connections. Within a chosen repeat cell, we formulate degree-compatible node assignments as a quotient-graph coloring problem and hold one linker template fixed on each edge. Colorings related by selected orientation-preserving symmetries of the embedded net define one candidate orbit; selected representatives are then used to construct oriented periodic models.% 对于固定的嵌入 MOF 网络，本文要解决的问题是识别对称互异的节点指派，并由这些指派构建构建单元连接相容的周期模型。在所选重复晶胞内，我们将度数相容的节点指派表述为商图着色问题，并在每条边上固定一个连接体模板。嵌入网络所选保向对称操作关联的着色构成同一候选轨道；随后以选定代表构建有取向的周期模型。
changes.after:
We study node-type arrangements within a chosen repeat cell of a fixed embedded MOF net. A single linker template is held fixed on every edge throughout node-assignment enumeration.

After these rotations, node-side and linker-side \texttt{X} endpoints with a Cartesian separation strictly below $0.8\,\text{\AA}$ are merged one-to-one. After fusion, the remaining topology-linked node--linker \texttt{X}--\texttt{X} pairs define the bridge connections. Their CIF bond-table entries use a nominal length of $1.485\,\text{\AA}$ without displacing the atomic coordinates; the geometric audit measures the actual \texttt{X}--\texttt{X} separation before this nominal value is applied. The numerical criteria used in these steps are listed in Supplementary Section~\ref{app:reconstruction_protocol}. The fixed-geometry scan in Appendix~\ref{app:x_fusion} examines this conservative operational cutoff.

After these rotations, the geometric audit measures the actual separations of topology-linked node--linker \texttt{X}--\texttt{X} pairs before endpoint fusion. Node-side and linker-side \texttt{X} endpoints with a Cartesian separation strictly below $0.8\,\text{\AA}$ are then merged one-to-one. changes.before:
The \texttt{ffc} and \texttt{fjh} cases permit exhaustive enumeration over their degree-compatible node pools. For these finite spaces, we checked that the returned representatives covered $X$ without duplicate $\Gamma$-orbits.
% 中文翻译：\texttt{ffc} 和 \texttt{fjh} 算例可对各自度数相容的节点模板池进行完整枚举。对这些有限空间，我们检查返回的代表是否覆盖 $X$，且不存在重复的 $\Gamma$-轨道。

For every exhaustive case, the represented orbit sizes summed to $|X|$. Distinct canonical representatives define disjoint $\Gamma$-orbits, so this sum counts the assignments covered and equality with $|X|$ confirms complete coverage. CASM provided a separate comparison on the same quotient graphs and node-label pools (Table~\ref{tab:casm}). % 对每个完整枚举算例，已表示轨道的大小之和均等于 $|X|$。不同规范代表对应互不相交的 $\Gamma$-轨道，因此轨道大小之和计数了已覆盖的指派；该和等于 $|X|$ 即确认完整覆盖。CASM 在相同商图和节点标签池上提供单独的比较（表~\ref{tab:casm}）。
Its native full factor group $F$ includes orientation-reversing operations in addition to the orientation-preserving operations retained here (Supplementary Table~\ref{tab:orbit_group_counts}). The \texttt{ffc} counts agree, providing a consistency check on the count computed for that benchmark space; this agreement does not establish that $F$ and $\Gamma$ define the same equivalence relation. For \texttt{fjh}, CASM gives fewer orbits under $F$, illustrating how the additional equivalences reduce the number of distinct candidates. The exact-coverage check therefore concerns the specified $\Gamma$ action, while the CASM comparison also exposes the effect of choosing a different equivalence group.
%其原生完整因子群 $F$ 还包含本文保向操作之外的反向操作（补充表~\ref{tab:orbit_group_counts}）。\texttt{ffc} 的计数一致，为该基准空间上的计数提供一致性检查；这一一致并不证明 $F$ 与 $\Gamma$ 定义相同的等价关系。对于 \texttt{fjh}，CASM 在 $F$ 下给出较少轨道，展示额外等价关系如何减少互异候选数。因此，精确覆盖核查针对所指定的 $\Gamma$ 作用，而 CASM 比较还展示了选择不同等价群的影响。
changes.after:
For each exhaustive case, distinct canonical representatives defined disjoint $\Gamma$-orbits whose sizes summed to $|X|$, confirming complete coverage. The matched CASM workflow used the same assignment space, group action, and output fields. After normalization to a common canonical convention, the complete representative records agreed.
% 中文翻译：对每个穷尽算例，不同规范代表定义互不相交的$\Gamma$轨道，其轨道大小之和等于$|X|$，确认完整覆盖。匹配CASM流程使用相同的指派空间、群作用和输出字段。转换到共同规范约定后，完整代表记录一致。

Enumeration wall times were lower for this method in 5 of the eight \texttt{ffc} and \texttt{fjh} cases in Table~\ref{tab:casm}. In the largest \texttt{fjh} case, 16,777,216 assignments yielded 1,078,816 orbits in 2.74 s, compared with 20.88 s for CASM. CASM was faster in the three smallest assignment spaces. These measurements support generating complete candidate libraries over the tested spaces, with relative performance dependent on the case.
% 中文翻译：在表~\ref{tab:casm}的八个ffc和fjh算例中，本文方法在五例上具有较低的枚举壁钟耗时。最大的fjh算例中，16,777,216个指派产生1,078,816个轨道，本文耗时2.74秒，CASM耗时20.88秒。CASM在原始指派空间最小的三个算例上更快。这些测量支持在被测空间中生成完整候选库，相对性能随算例变化。

CASM's native full factor group $F$ additionally includes orientation-reversing operations. Its orbit counts are reported separately in Supplementary Table~\ref{tab:orbit_group_counts}, showing the effect of the equivalence group.
% 中文翻译：CASM的原生完整因子群$F$另包含反向操作。其轨道计数单列于补充表~\ref{tab:orbit_group_counts}，说明所选等价群的影响。
